style.name: Y2K
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Y2K. Use chrome gradients, translucent aqua and hot pink, glossy interface panels, rounded techno typography and optimistic turn-of-the-millennium digital motifs. Verified facts, maps, charts and operating signals occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or bottom.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 9月6日全球经营雷达聚焦欧盟电商税、Astra安全、霍尔木兹能源风险、外交与极端天气
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者要同时校准税务数据、AI权限、物流能源敞口、人员安全与灾害连续性
zh-CN.headlineFull: 9月6日全球经营雷达聚焦欧盟电商税、Astra安全、霍尔木兹能源风险、外交与极端天气；经营者要同时校准税务数据、AI权限、物流能源敞口、人员安全与灾害连续性
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟跨境电商VAT申报规模继续扩大，Astra达到关键网络安全能力门槛；美伊海上冲突、俄乌新一轮谈判、英国港口封堵、玻利维亚军营爆炸与太平洋三场热带气旋，构成今天的经营风险地图。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 把热点放进同一张图，才能看见责任和成本如何相互传导。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今天先检查税、权限、能源和人员四条预案。

en-US.headlineFact: The September 6 operating radar centers on EU e-commerce VAT, Astra safeguards, Hormuz energy risk, diplomacy and extreme weather
en-US.headlineView: operators need tax data, AI permissions, logistics and energy exposure, staff safety and disaster continuity on one dashboard
en-US.headlineFull: The September 6 operating radar centers on EU e-commerce VAT, Astra safeguards, Hormuz energy risk, diplomacy and extreme weather; operators need tax data, AI permissions, logistics and energy exposure, staff safety and disaster continuity on one dashboard
en-US.intro: EU cross-border e-commerce VAT reporting keeps expanding while Astra reaches a critical cybersecurity capability threshold. US-Iran maritime strikes, renewed Ukraine diplomacy, a Dover port blockade, explosions at a Bolivian barracks and three Pacific cyclones complete today's operating-risk map.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Put headlines on one map to see how responsibility and cost transmit together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Check tax, permissions, energy and people plans first today.

sources.title: September 5 2026 global business technology security climate news

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟电商OSS与IOSS五年累计申报VAT超过1250亿欧元，2025年达380亿欧元
zh-CN.headlineView: 跨境卖家要把注册主体、平台代扣、IOSS编号和订单级税务数据重新对表
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟电商OSS与IOSS五年累计申报VAT超过1250亿欧元，2025年达380亿欧元；跨境卖家要把注册主体、平台代扣、IOSS编号和订单级税务数据重新对表
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟委员会公布，2025年通过OSS与IOSS申报的VAT同比增长17%，相关注册企业超过19.3万家。制度使用规模扩大意味着税务数据会更可比、更可追踪；卖家应核对销售国、货值、平台身份、退货和发票链路，避免把简化申报误解为弱化合规。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 税务流程越简化，底层订单数据越需要准确。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 随机抽十单，把收款、税号、申报和退款串起来。

en-US.headlineFact: EU e-commerce OSS and IOSS schemes have collected more than EUR125 billion in VAT over five years, including EUR38 billion in 2025
en-US.headlineView: cross-border sellers should reconcile registration entities, marketplace collection, IOSS numbers and order-level tax data
en-US.headlineFull: EU e-commerce OSS and IOSS schemes have collected more than EUR125 billion in VAT over five years, including EUR38 billion in 2025; cross-border sellers should reconcile registration entities, marketplace collection, IOSS numbers and order-level tax data
en-US.intro: The European Commission said VAT declared through OSS and IOSS grew 17% in 2025 and registrations exceeded 193,000. Broader use makes tax data more comparable and traceable. Sellers should audit destination country, value, platform role, returns and invoice trails instead of mistaking simpler filing for lighter compliance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The simpler the tax workflow, the more accurate the underlying order data must be.
en-US.doudouQuote: Sample ten orders and connect payment, tax ID, filing and refund.

sources.title: EU VAT rules for e-commerce, five years on: More than EUR125 billion in VAT revenue

zh-CN.headlineFact: OpenAI确认Astra达到关键级网络安全能力门槛，并以更强防护推进发布
zh-CN.headlineView: 高能力模型进入业务前，权限隔离、持续监控、用途分级与紧急停机必须先于规模化
zh-CN.headlineFull: OpenAI确认Astra达到关键级网络安全能力门槛，并以更强防护推进发布；高能力模型进入业务前，权限隔离、持续监控、用途分级与紧急停机必须先于规模化
zh-CN.intro: OpenAI表示，Astra可在适当工具和访问条件下发现未知漏洞并制定利用策略，因此延缓了部分开发并加强拒绝训练、滥用防护和未授权行为监控。企业不应把模型升级当作普通软件更新，而要用最小权限、沙箱、审批和审计日志建立分层准入。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 能力跨过门槛时，治理也要跨过门槛。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先决定模型能碰什么，再决定它能做多快。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: OpenAI says Astra has reached the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold and is moving toward release with stronger safeguards
en-US.headlineView: permission isolation, continuous monitoring, tiered use and emergency shutdown must precede scaling high-capability models
en-US.headlineFull: OpenAI says Astra has reached the Critical cybersecurity capability threshold and is moving toward release with stronger safeguards; permission isolation, continuous monitoring, tiered use and emergency shutdown must precede scaling high-capability models
en-US.intro: OpenAI says Astra can find unknown vulnerabilities and develop exploitation strategies with suitable tools and access, prompting delays to some development and stronger refusal training, misuse defenses and unauthorized-action monitoring. Enterprises should treat model upgrades as gated capability changes, using least privilege, sandboxes, approvals and audit logs.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When capability crosses a threshold, governance must cross one too.
en-US.doudouQuote: Decide what the model may touch before deciding how fast it may work.

sources.title: OpenAI Astra critical cybersecurity capability safeguards September 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: Metal获450万美元种子轮融资，用AI操作系统自动化创始人的募资流程
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司应把投资人研究、材料版本与跟进节奏交给系统，但保留关系判断和最终发送权
zh-CN.headlineFull: Metal获450万美元种子轮融资，用AI操作系统自动化创始人的募资流程；一人公司应把投资人研究、材料版本与跟进节奏交给系统，但保留关系判断和最终发送权
zh-CN.intro: 这家由Airlift联合创始人创建的公司把融资情报、材料组织和流程自动化放进一个AI原生入口，并称已连续六个季度实现30%至80%的季度增长。独立经营者可借鉴其方法：先标准化名单、证据和提醒，再让AI准备草稿，关键承诺与外发仍由本人确认。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI可以压缩融资杂务，不能替你承担承诺。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 让系统准备下一步，把发送按钮留给创始人。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: Metal raised USD4.5 million for an AI operating system that automates founders' fundraising workflows
en-US.headlineView: solo companies can systematize investor research, document versions and follow-up cadence while retaining relationship judgment and final send authority
en-US.headlineFull: Metal raised USD4.5 million for an AI operating system that automates founders' fundraising workflows; solo companies can systematize investor research, document versions and follow-up cadence while retaining relationship judgment and final send authority
en-US.intro: Founded by an Airlift co-founder, Metal combines fundraising intelligence, document organization and workflow automation in an AI-native product and reports six consecutive quarters of 30% to 80% quarterly growth. Solo operators can standardize lists, evidence and reminders, let AI prepare drafts, and personally approve commitments and outbound messages.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI can compress fundraising chores; it cannot carry your commitments.
en-US.doudouQuote: Let the system prepare the next step and keep Send with the founder.

sources.title: Airlift Co-Founder's AI Startup Metal Raises $4.5 Million

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国在军舰遭导弹袭击后打击三艘伊朗油轮，海上冲突再次升级
zh-CN.headlineView: 企业要重估霍尔木兹相关的燃料、航线、保险、交付时点与替代供应成本
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国在军舰遭导弹袭击后打击三艘伊朗油轮，海上冲突再次升级；企业要重估霍尔木兹相关的燃料、航线、保险、交付时点与替代供应成本
zh-CN.intro: 美军表示，伊朗向一艘航母和一艘驱逐舰发动多次袭击后，美方打击了三艘与伊朗石油网络相关的油轮。靠近霍尔木兹与哈尔克岛的军事行动把能源供应与商业航运风险重新绑在一起，进口商和物流团队应更新情景价格与延误阈值。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 海上冲突不只改变油价，也改变每一份交付承诺。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 把燃料、保险和绕航时间一起做压力测试。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：海湾能源风险。

en-US.headlineFact: US forces struck three Iranian oil tankers after missiles targeted Navy warships, escalating maritime conflict
en-US.headlineView: businesses should reprice fuel, routes, insurance, delivery timing and alternative supply tied to the Strait of Hormuz
en-US.headlineFull: US forces struck three Iranian oil tankers after missiles targeted Navy warships, escalating maritime conflict; businesses should reprice fuel, routes, insurance, delivery timing and alternative supply tied to the Strait of Hormuz
en-US.intro: The US military said it hit three tankers linked to Iran's oil network after multiple attacks on an aircraft carrier and a destroyer. Military action near Hormuz and Kharg Island reconnects energy supply with commercial-shipping risk. Importers and logistics teams should update scenario prices and delay thresholds.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Maritime conflict changes not only oil prices but every delivery promise.
en-US.doudouQuote: Stress-test fuel, insurance and rerouting time together.

sources.title: US strikes three Iranian oil tankers after Navy warships targeted

zh-CN.headlineFact: 普京在克里姆林宫会见美国特使，并宣布对基辅三天停火
zh-CN.headlineView: 短暂停火为谈判与恢复创造窗口，却不足以取消供应链和人员连续性预案
zh-CN.headlineFull: 普京在克里姆林宫会见美国特使，并宣布对基辅三天停火；短暂停火为谈判与恢复创造窗口，却不足以取消供应链和人员连续性预案
zh-CN.intro: 美国推动结束战争的谈判重新启动，俄罗斯宣布从当地时间午夜起三天内不袭击基辅；与此同时，其他地区战斗与远程打击仍在继续。跨境团队应把停火视为有限窗口，用于人员轮换、库存检查与通信测试，而不是立即撤除风险缓冲。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 外交窗口值得利用，但不能被误读为风险已经消失。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 趁窗口补库存、测通信，别急着拆掉备份。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：乌克兰外交。

en-US.headlineFact: Putin met US envoys at the Kremlin and announced a three-day pause in strikes on Kyiv
en-US.headlineView: a limited ceasefire opens space for talks and recovery but does not cancel supply-chain or staff-continuity plans
en-US.headlineFull: Putin met US envoys at the Kremlin and announced a three-day pause in strikes on Kyiv; a limited ceasefire opens space for talks and recovery but does not cancel supply-chain or staff-continuity plans
en-US.intro: US efforts to end the war resumed as Russia announced no strikes on Kyiv for three days from midnight, while fighting and long-range attacks continued elsewhere. Cross-border teams should use the pause for staff rotation, inventory checks and communications tests rather than immediately removing risk buffers.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Use a diplomatic window without mistaking it for the end of risk.
en-US.doudouQuote: Restock and test communications before removing backup capacity.

sources.title: Putin meets US envoys Kremlin renewed Ukraine talks three-day Kyiv pause

zh-CN.headlineFact: 蒙面抗议者封堵通往多佛港的道路，英法旅客与货运车辆受阻
zh-CN.headlineView: 关键港口的陆侧拥堵提醒物流团队，港到港之外还要监控最后一段公路与司机工时
zh-CN.headlineFull: 蒙面抗议者封堵通往多佛港的道路，英法旅客与货运车辆受阻；关键港口的陆侧拥堵提醒物流团队，港到港之外还要监控最后一段公路与司机工时
zh-CN.intro: 数百名抗议者在英国最繁忙的渡轮港口外封路，造成前往法国的旅客与货车积压。跨境履约不能只关注船期；车队排队、司机工时、冷链温度、替代口岸和客户通知阈值，也应进入实时控制面板。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一条港口道路，也可能成为整条供应链的单点故障。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 给每条海运线路再配一个陆侧替代方案。

en-US.headlineFact: Masked protesters blocked roads into Dover, disrupting travelers and cargo vehicles bound for France
en-US.headlineView: landside congestion at a critical port shows logistics teams must monitor the final road leg and driver hours, not only sailings
en-US.headlineFull: Masked protesters blocked roads into Dover, disrupting travelers and cargo vehicles bound for France; landside congestion at a critical port shows logistics teams must monitor the final road leg and driver hours, not only sailings
en-US.intro: Hundreds of protesters blocked access to Britain's busiest ferry port, creating queues for passengers and trucks heading to France. Cross-border fulfillment needs visibility beyond vessel schedules: fleet queues, driver hours, cold-chain temperature, alternative ports and customer-notification thresholds belong on the live control board.
en-US.xiaziQuote: One port road can become a single point of failure for an entire supply chain.
en-US.doudouQuote: Give every sea route a landside alternative.

sources.title: Masked protesters block roads into Dover port disrupting cargo vehicles

zh-CN.headlineFact: 玻利维亚Viacha军营接连爆炸，造成死亡、失踪与数十人受伤
zh-CN.headlineView: 危险品设施必须把库存分区、周边疏散、医疗联动与事故透明纳入同一套演练
zh-CN.headlineFull: 玻利维亚Viacha军营接连爆炸，造成死亡、失踪与数十人受伤；危险品设施必须把库存分区、周边疏散、医疗联动与事故透明纳入同一套演练
zh-CN.intro: 拉巴斯附近一处存放烟火材料的军事设施发生两次爆炸，周边房屋受损，伤亡数字仍在更新。高风险仓储与生产场所应定期核对物料清单、隔离距离、消防水源、群众疏散路线和跨机构通讯，避免第二次事件扩大第一次事故。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 危险品管理的边界，不应止于仓库围墙。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 第二次爆炸前，预案必须已经能让周边人群离开。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：玻利维亚爆炸。

en-US.headlineFact: Successive explosions at a military barracks in Viacha, Bolivia caused deaths, missing people and dozens of injuries
en-US.headlineView: hazardous-material sites need one practiced system for inventory separation, neighborhood evacuation, medical coordination and incident transparency
en-US.headlineFull: Successive explosions at a military barracks in Viacha, Bolivia caused deaths, missing people and dozens of injuries; hazardous-material sites need one practiced system for inventory separation, neighborhood evacuation, medical coordination and incident transparency
en-US.intro: Two blasts hit a military facility storing pyrotechnic material near La Paz, damaging nearby homes as casualty figures continued to change. High-risk storage and production sites should audit material inventories, separation distances, fire-water access, public evacuation routes and interagency communications before a second event compounds the first.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The boundary of hazardous-material management cannot stop at the warehouse wall.
en-US.doudouQuote: People nearby must be moving before a second blast occurs.

sources.title: Bolivia Viacha military barracks explosions deaths injuries September 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA卫星同时拍到太平洋三场热带气旋，其中Lowell一度达到5级
zh-CN.headlineView: 厄尔尼诺正在把风暴活跃度推向太平洋，沿岸企业要按流域而非单一国家配置连续性
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA卫星同时拍到太平洋三场热带气旋，其中Lowell一度达到5级；厄尔尼诺正在把风暴活跃度推向太平洋，沿岸企业要按流域而非单一国家配置连续性
zh-CN.intro: DSCOVR卫星拍到Lowell、Karina和Marie同时在太平洋旋转；截至9月3日，东北太平洋已有15场命名风暴和6场飓风，显著高于同期常态。港口、渔业、旅游和跨境物流应按多风暴并发情景检查路线、库存、能源与通信备份。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 季节预测的意义，是让准备早于卫星图上的漩涡。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 三场风暴同时出现，就别只准备一条绕行路线。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与飓风。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA imagery captured three Pacific tropical cyclones at once, with Lowell briefly reaching Category 5 strength
en-US.headlineView: El Nino is shifting storm activity toward the Pacific, so coastal businesses need basin-wide rather than single-country continuity planning
en-US.headlineFull: NASA imagery captured three Pacific tropical cyclones at once, with Lowell briefly reaching Category 5 strength; El Nino is shifting storm activity toward the Pacific, so coastal businesses need basin-wide rather than single-country continuity planning
en-US.intro: DSCOVR captured Lowell, Karina and Marie spinning simultaneously in the Pacific. By September 3, the Northeast Pacific had produced 15 named storms and six hurricanes, well above normal for the date. Ports, fisheries, tourism and cross-border logistics should test routes, inventory, power and communications against concurrent storms.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Seasonal forecasts matter when preparation starts before the swirl appears on satellite imagery.
en-US.doudouQuote: Three storms at once demand more than one detour.

sources.title: NASA three Pacific tropical cyclones Lowell Karina Marie September 2026
